那些交了钱的弟子原本以为没有事了，却没有想到眼前的老弟子照打不误。其中有的弟子忍受不了这个事情，心中十分地委屈，心道我们已经交了钱了，为什么还要打我们？此时他们已经被打到在地，正被那些老弟子门踹着。心中越想越委屈，终于大声地喊了出来：
“我们已经交钱了，为什么还要打我们？”
“哈哈哈……”
老弟子们一顿爆笑，脚下踹得更加地起劲。而此时在大殿附近的一座阁楼上，几个老师正在窗口边喝着茶边向着大殿门口张望着。其中就有刚才给许紫烟他们她们上课的那位中年老师。
“民哥，看来今天这些新进弟子又要脱一层皮啊！”一个年纪略小的人对给许紫烟他们上课的那位老师说道。
“这也没什么不好，让他们知耻而后勇。”
“噢？”那个年纪略轻的人闻言一愣，继而轻笑道：“民哥，你今天的态度可是不对啊！你以往不是很看不惯那些老弟子欺负新弟子吗？”
“哼，老弟子欺负新弟子自然不对。可是若是新弟子不求上进，那教训她一下，也未尝不是好事。”
“噢？”
这一下其他的人也来了兴趣，有人便抢着开口问道：“难道有谁惹到你了？”
“哼，一个不知道天高地厚的小丫头。”那位民哥的脸此时拉得更长，整个脸阴沉沉地说道：
“在我讲课的时候东张西望，当我讲完的时候，其他的弟子都在思索领悟，就她一个人左右他顾，这样的弟子不教训她一顿，哪里还会有丝毫的长进？”
“你说的是哪一个？”
“就是那个站在大殿台阶上的那个身穿蓝色衣服的丫头。”
阁楼上的众人都向着许紫烟望去，而此时在大殿之前，那些听到新进弟子喊冤的老弟子们大笑之后，将那些交了钱的弟子狠狠地收拾一顿之后，抬头望向了那些剩下的没有交钱的新进弟子。张狂地喝道：
“告诉你们，今天我们这些老弟子就给你们这些新弟子上一课，我们不但要你们的钱，还好狠狠地揍你们一顿，让你们知道知道规矩。来，都主动地过来，一个个地给我们跪下，把屁股给我撅起来。”
那些剩下的新进弟子脸上尽是一片慌乱，先交钱的那些新进弟子都是一些家世比较好的，能够拿出一些钱的弟子。而剩下的这些新近弟子都是家族中一些穷苦人家的孩子。那里有钱交给老弟子？就是家里给凑出了一点钱，也是他们仅有的一点积蓄，所以开始他们就很犹豫，并没有出去把钱交给那些老弟子。
如今看到即使交了钱也要挨打，就更不肯交出自己仅有的积蓄了。他们也不是没有兴起想要反抗之心，可是看到对方的修为，自己明显不是人家的对手。想到就要被对方尽情的羞辱，脸上便现出恐惧之色。那些老弟子看到他们脸上的恐惧之色，心中更加地舒畅，不禁笑得更加地大声起来。
站在许紫烟身边的许丽，许铁牛，许凌和许德志也满脸的恐慌，尤其是那许丽，想到自己一个女孩子要跪在地上，而且要把屁屁高高撅起，心中连死的心都有了，脸上已经是一片苍白。只有许紫烟和许清雪两个人的脸上十分地平静。

许紫烟的平静是因为自己的修为高于那些老弟子，并不惧怕他们，唯一担心的就是暴露出自己的真实修为。而许清雪是性格如此，一贯地冷冰冰的，脸上没有丝毫的变化。不过脸上没有没有变化，不代表着心中不气愤。听到对方要自己跪下，而且还要撅起屁屁，许清雪便按捺不住心中的愤怒，娇斥一声：
“禽兽！”
“哦？”
在场所有的人都转头望了过来，震惊地向着大殿门口的方向望了过来，都想要看看究竟是谁喊出了“禽兽”这连个字。
大家都听到了是一个女子的声音，所以众人的目光都在许紫烟，许清雪和许丽三个人的身上扫来扫去。
“哈！”
一个老弟子笑了一声，色迷迷地望着许紫烟三人说道：
“原来那里有三个妞啊，来，快过来，把屁屁撅起来，让哥哥拍两下，就不要你们的钱的。”
“哈哈哈……”一群老弟子放肆地笑着，还有人喊道：“来，到哥哥这里来，哥哥不打你屁屁，只要让哥哥摸一下胸就行。”

Those disciples who paid the money originally thought that nothing would happen, but they did not expect that the old disciple in front of them would follow suit. Some of the disciples couldn't stand this and felt very aggrieved. They thought, "We have already paid the money, so why do we still need to be beaten?" At this time, they had been beaten to the ground and were being kicked by the old disciples. The more I thought about it, the more aggrieved I became, and finally I shouted loudly:
"We have already paid, why are you still beating us?"
"Hahaha..."
The old disciples burst into laughter and kicked their feet even harder. At this time, in an attic near the main hall, several teachers were drinking tea by the window and looking towards the entrance of the main hall. Among them was the middle-aged teacher who just taught Xu Ziyan and the others.
"Brother Min, it seems that these new disciples are going to shed another layer of skin today!" A slightly younger person said to the teacher who taught Xu Ziyan and the others.
"There is nothing wrong with this. Let them know their shame and then be brave."
"Oh?" The slightly younger man was stunned when he heard this, and then chuckled: "Brother Min, your attitude is wrong today! Aren't you used to dislike those old disciples bullying new disciples?"
"Huh, it's not right for an old disciple to bully a new disciple. But if the new disciple doesn't strive to make progress, then it might not be a bad thing to teach her a lesson."
"Oh?"
At this time, other people also became interested, and someone rushed to ask: "Did someone offend you?"
"Huh, a little girl who doesn't know how high the sky is." Brother Min's face stretched even longer at this time, and his whole face said gloomily:
"She looked around while I was giving a lecture. When I finished speaking, the other disciples were all thinking and comprehending. She was the only one who looked after others. If such a disciple doesn't teach her a lesson, how can he make any progress?"
"Which one are you talking about?"
"That's the girl in blue standing on the steps of the main hall."
Everyone in the attic looked towards Xu Ziyan, and at this time in front of the main hall, the old disciples who heard the new disciples crying out for grievances laughed, and after severely punishing the disciples who had paid, they looked up at the remaining new disciples who had not paid. He shouted arrogantly:
"Let me tell you, today we old disciples will teach you new disciples a lesson. Not only do we want your money, but we will also give you a good beating so that you know the rules. Come here, come over proactively, kneel down for us one by one, and stick your butts out for me."
The faces of the remaining new disciples were full of panic. The new disciples who paid the money first were those from relatively good family backgrounds who could afford some money. The remaining recent disciples are all children from poor families in the family. Where is the money to give to old disciples? Even though their family had scraped together a little money, it was their only savings, so they were very hesitant at first and did not go out and give the money to the old disciples.
Now that I see that I will be beaten even if I pay the money, I am even more unwilling to hand over my only savings. It was not that they didn't want to resist, but seeing the opponent's cultivation, they were obviously no match for them. Thinking of being humiliated by the other party, a look of fear appeared on his face. Seeing the fear on their faces, those old disciples felt more comfortable and couldn't help but laugh even louder.
Xu Li, Xu Tieniu, Xu Ling and Xu Dezhi standing next to Xu Ziyan were also full of panic, especially Xu Li. Thinking that she, a girl, had to kneel on the ground and raise her butt high, she even had the heart to die, and her face was already pale. Only Xu Ziyan and Xu Qingxue had very calm faces.
Xu Ziyan's calmness is because his cultivation is higher than those of his old disciples.He is not afraid of them, the only thing he worries about is exposing his true cultivation level. And Xu Qingxue's personality was always cold, without any change on her face. However, the fact that his face has not changed does not mean that he is not angry in his heart. Hearing that the other party wanted to kneel down and stick out his butt, Xu Qingxue couldn't hold back the anger in her heart and scolded:
"Beast!"
"Oh?"
Everyone present turned their heads and looked towards the door of the hall in shock, wanting to see who had shouted the word "animal".
Everyone heard the voice of a woman, so everyone's eyes were scanning Xu Ziyan, Xu Qingxue and Xu Li.
"Ha!"
An old disciple laughed, looked at Xu Ziyan and the others in fascination and said:
"It turns out there are three girls there. Come on, come here, stick your butts up, and let me pat them twice. I won't take your money."
"Hahaha..." A group of old disciples laughed wildly, and someone shouted: "Come, come to my brother, I won't spank you, just let me touch your breasts."
